fresh_universe.name: q017_coverage_first
fresh_universe.rationale: Fixed ex ante, symbol-disjoint across the repository's registered research universes; no return metric is used.

macro.point_in_time_rule: Use values from the first vintage in which an observation is available; later revisions are not eligible.
macro.daily_action_rule: Any release-derived state may act no earlier than the next eligible trading bar.
macro.coverage_requirement: Complete observation-date coverage and vintage availability over the fixed study window; otherwise DATA_INSUFFICIENT.

cftc.source: CFTC Disaggregated Futures Only historical compressed archives
cftc.point_in_time_rule: Report observations are usable only after their public release. Default publication schedule is Friday 15:30 ET following Tuesday report data; historical exceptions are tracked as a coverage limitation unless explicitly verified.
cftc.coverage_requirement: Complete weekly market/date presence for the fixed mappings over the study window; otherwise DATA_INSUFFICIENT.

turnover_liquidity.point_in_time_rule: Use only the decision-bar OHLCV and act on the next eligible daily bar.
turnover_liquidity.coverage_requirement: At least 3500 common daily candles after fixed-window filtering for all eight symbols; otherwise DATA_INVALID.
